# Penpot

> > Penpot is an open-source design platform built for seamless collaboration between designers and developers, with native code integration and self-hosting capabilities.

Penpot is a web-based design tool that bridges design and development workflows through CSS/SVG integration, real-time collaboration, and an extensible plugin ecosystem. The platform supports both cloud and self-hosted deployments, making it suitable for teams of all sizes and enterprise requirements.

## Key Topics

- Open-source design platform
- Design-to-code collaboration
- Real-time multiplayer design
- SVG and CSS integration
- Design systems and tokens
- Self-hosting and deployment
- API integrations and webhooks
- Plugin ecosystem
- Responsive design
- Design libraries and templates
- Prototyping
- DesignOps and GitOps
- Penpot Hub
- Design tokens
- Flex layout and CSS Grid
